title: Test: planted state, a staff key copy, the deploy password and the settlement batch
story: An engine test, not one of the bench's scenarios: the intruder box gets ways in that are older than the logs (a key line, a file), a copy of Nico's key and the deploy password.
Each one is used once. The settlement batch pays the two invoices of the week at +600 s.

files.text: UPDATE billing.invoices SET paid_at=CURDATE() WHERE id IN (6,7);

notes: Test scenario for the engine only. Each step is one harmless login that runs a read-only command.
